subject: Hosted API usage buckets, budget targets, and peak TPS clarifications
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <p.shah@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API usage buckets, budget targets, and peak TPS clarifications

Hi Priyanka — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get an accurate hosted pricing estimate over to your procurement team.

Recap from the call:
- Primary use case: conversational customer support + short generative snippets inside the Catalyst Console.
- Expected mix: ~75% chat generation (avg response 250 tokens), 25% embeddings for search & rerank.
- Latency SLO target: 200–400ms p50 for chat flows; occasional spikes acceptable for longer generations.

Open items we discussed (can you confirm the bold items?):
1) Monthly tokens: you mentioned an initial band of 60–120M tokens/month for the first 3 months, with growth to 300–500M at scale. Please confirm an initial committed band you prefer.
2) Peak TPS (chat requests/sec): you estimated a sustained peak of ~18–22 r/s with burst to 60 r/s for short windows. Can you confirm 95th pct peak or provide a short daily peak profile?
3) Budget target: you referenced an internal cost ceiling of ~$900 per 1M generated tokens (hosted). Is that still the working target?

Next steps I propose:
- Priyanka: confirm a single committed band for months 1–3 so I can price a starter slab + burst add-on.
- Marissa: if you can validate feasibility of 60–70ms model execution overhead and recommend a quantized variant that fits the latency SLOs, that would help finalize the estimate.
- Karthik: please prepare a short note on how concurrency/batching would affect unit cost at 100M vs 400M tokens.

I attached a quick traffic profile template (catalyst_traffic_profile.xlsx) — fill the highlighted rows if you can.

Thanks — aiming to get a formal hosted estimate and a draft mutual action plan by Friday.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: catalyst_traffic_profile.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Priyanka Shah <p.shah@catalyst.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted API usage buckets, budget targets, and peak TPS clarifications

Hi Monica — thanks for the detailed recap and the template. Quick answers inline: 

- Monthly committed band: we can commit to a starter slab of 75M generated tokens/mo for the first quarter (we'll revisit at the end of Q1).
- Peak TPS: our load tests show ~20 r/s sustained during business hours (US PST), with planned feature releases that could cause short bursts up to ~65 r/s for 30–90s. Happy to share a daily peak CSV (will attach).
- Budget: $900 / 1M tokens is our target for hosted if it includes model + token compute and basic observability. If reserved pricing is required to hit that, flag it.

Notes: our support team has a hard requirement that conversational latency p95 < 800ms (p50 target like you called out is fine). Also, embeddings volume is low initially — estimate 2–4M vectors / month.

Attaching a brief traffic export and our procurement contact (cc'd billing).

Thanks,
Priyanka Shah
Head of Product Operations | CatalystAI
p.shah@catalyst.ai

Attachments: catalyst_daily_peaks.csv

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <p.shah@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API usage buckets, budget targets, and peak TPS clarifications

Priyanka — perfect, that starter slab helps a lot. Looping in Marissa (solutions) and Karthik (infra) to validate a few unit econ assumptions and confirm whether the $900/1M target is achievable on hosted without an upfront commit.

Marissa / Karthik — two specific asks: 
1) Can we keep p95 below 800ms on the recommended hosted config for the chat profile above at 20 r/s sustained and 65 r/s 90s bursts? If so, what model variant/quantization level should we propose?
2) Rough unit cost delta: what would $/1M tokens look like at 75M, 200M, and 400M token monthly volumes with typical batching turned on (assume average generation 250 tokens)? 

I'll draft the hosted slab pricing once I get your numbers — we'll attach the estimate (PDF) and a short mutual action plan for procurement.

Thanks all,
Monica

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API usage buckets, budget targets, and peak TPS clarifications

Thanks Monica — ran a quick feasibility pass. Summary below (high level). More detail in the attached estimate.

- Latency / SLA: recommended hosted variant (quantized medium transformer) should meet p50 ~220ms and p95 ~610–780ms for 250-token responses at 20 r/s. During 65 r/s 90s bursts we expect p95 to drift toward ~900ms unless we provision burst capacity.
- Unit economics (hosted, including model + infra + basic observability):
  • 75M tokens/mo -> ~$1,050 / 1M tokens (starter slab, modest burst buffer)
  • 200M tokens/mo -> ~$970 / 1M tokens (better batching efficiency)
  • 400M tokens/mo -> ~$820 / 1M tokens (full batching and cache savings)

Observations: $900/1M target is reachable between 200–400M with typical optimizations. For the 75M starter slab, to hit $900 we'd need either a short-term promotional credit or a 12mo reserved commit.

Next steps I recommend:
- Monica: propose a staged slab (75M starter, 200M at month 4) with a burst buffer add-on; show both list and committed pricing.
- Priyanka: confirm whether procurement prefers a short reserved term or flexible hosted pricing + credits.
- Karthik: schedule a 30-min infra sync to validate burst behavior and whether we should recommend autoscale thresholds.

Attaching the quick estimate PDF for Catalysts' procurement and a short SLA note.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_estimate_v1.pdf, sla_note.txt
